ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no driver-side no-show is established — driver was ~2.5 km from the pickup point at cancellation, so no I'm Here press or 3-minute wait existed. Flag the driver's account for repeat cancelling/no-show-related fee issues (driver no_show_disputes_upheld_90d = 2).

rejected_claims.reason: Driver says he was 'on my way' — consistent with GPS, but the fare was charged to the rider for a cancellation made 2:30 after matching; under NS-4 no fee is chargeable within 3 minutes, and the driver never pressed 'I'm Here' nor waited at the pickup point (NS-1 not met).

Rider's ground that 'the driver was nowhere near' is not itself a policy basis (Ryde has no ETA-based waiver, NS-8 not citable); the refund rests on the 3-minute rule (NS-4) and the failed no-show conditions (NS-1/NS-2).
